## Loading packages

```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(DESeq2)
library(Rsubread)
library(apeglm)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(pheatmap)
library(tidyverse)
```

# HANDS-ON SESSION 2

## Get count table from BAM files

```{r}
# Get BAM files
 bam_files <- list.files(pattern = "\\.bam$")
 # Get GFF file
 gff_file <- "genomic.gff"
```

```{r}
# Create count table
 counts <- featureCounts(files = bam_files, annot.ext = gff_file, 
isGTFAnnotationFile = TRUE, GTF.featureType = "gene", 
GTF.attrType = "Name", isPairedEnd = TRUE,
 requireBothEndsMapped = TRUE, nthreads = 4)
```

```{r}
# Show count table
counts$counts
# or just first six lines of the count table
head(counts$counts)
# Show the position of the genes (extracted from GFF file) (first six lines)
head(counts$annotation)
# Show our input BAM files
counts$targets
# Show the summary statistics of our read quantification
counts$stat


# Obtain the count table from the counts object
count_table <- data.frame(counts["counts"])
# Change column names
# Make sure that the column names correspond with the correct condition
# First three samples were in glycerol medium, last three samples were in succinate medium
colnames(count_table) <- c("glycerol_1", "glycerol_2", "glycerol_3",
"succinate_1", "succinate_2", "succinate_3")
# Take a look at the count table
head(count_table)
```

## Count table input in DESeq2

```{r}
# Create coldata data.frame
coldata <- data.frame(row.names = c("glycerol_1", "glycerol_2", "glycerol_3",
"succinate_1", "succinate_2", "succinate_3"),
condition = c(rep("glycerol", 3), rep("succinate", 3)),
type = rep("paired-end", 6))
coldata$condition <- factor(coldata$condition)
coldata$type <- factor(coldata$type)
# Take a look at coldata
coldata
# Create DESeqDataSet from our count table and additional column information
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = count_table,
colData = coldata,
design = ~ condition)
# Take a look at DESeqDataSet
dds
```

## Filtering of genes

```{r}
 # Select the genes (rows) that have at least 10 reads summed over all samples
 keep <- rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10
 # Subset the dataset by only keeping the genes that pass the filter
 dds <- dds[keep,]
 dds

```

## Differential expression analysis

```{r}
 # Perform the differential expression analysis and store the results in the dds object
 dds <- DESeq(dds)
 # Get the results of the analysis
 res <- results(dds, contrast=c("condition", "succinate", "glycerol"),
 alpha = 0.01)
 res
 # Shrink log-fold changes
 resLFC <- lfcShrink(dds, coef="condition_succinate_vs_glycerol", type="apeglm")
 resLFC
```

```{r}
 # Show summary of results
 summary(resLFC, alpha = 0.01)
 # Show number of differentially expressed genes that have an adjusted p-value < 0.01
 sum(resLFC$padj < 0.01, na.rm=TRUE)

```

```{r}
 # Order genes based on the adjusted p-value
 resLFCordered <- resLFC[order(resLFC$padj),]
 resLFCordered
```

```{r}
# Search for dcuB gene
resLFC["dcuB",]
```

```{r}
# Save figure
 plotCounts(dds, gene="atpD", intgroup="condition")
 jpeg(file="atpD.jpeg")
 plotCounts(dds, gene="atpD", intgroup="condition")
 dev.off()
```

### Heatmap

```{r}
library(grid)
 # Select the top 20 genes
select <- rownames(resLFCordered[1:20, ])

 # Plot heatmap
top_counts <- log2(counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)[rownames(dds) %in% select, ])

# Save heatmap to JPEG
jpeg("TOP.jpeg", width = 800, height = 800)

p <- pheatmap(top_counts,
              main = "Top 20 DEGs",
              fontsize_row = 8,
              fontsize_col = 10,
              silent = TRUE)  

grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(p$gtable)
```

### Volcano plot

```{r}

```

## GO over-representation analysis

```{r}
# Get significant genes (adjusted p-value < 0.01)
 sign_genes <- resLFC[!is.na(resLFC$padj),]
 sign_genes <- sign_genes[sign_genes$padj < 0.01,]
 # Collecting the up-regulated genes
 up_reg <- sign_genes[sign_genes$log2FoldChange > 0,]
 # Check up-regulated genes and number of them
 up_reg
 nrow(up_reg)
 # Get up-regulated gene names
 up_reg_genes <- rownames(up_reg)
 # Collecting the down-regulated genes
 down_reg <- sign_genes[sign_genes$log2FoldChange < 0,]
 # Check down-regulated genes and number of them
 down_reg
 nrow(down_reg)
 # Get down-regulated gene names
 down_reg_genes <- rownames(down_reg)
```

```{r}
# Get gene list of all genes
gene_list <- rownames(resLFC)
```

```{r}
# Load in GO file
GO2gene <- read.delim("GO2gene.tsv", col.names = c("GO", "gene"))
```

```{r}
# Perform GO over-representation analysis for up-regulated genes
GOoverrep_up <- enricher(gene = up_reg_genes, 
universe = gene_list,
 TERM2GENE = GO2gene)

head(GOoverrep_up)
 GOoverrep_up
```

```{r}
# Get GO description that is linked to GO ID (for up-regulated genes)
GOoverrep_up_df <- GOoverrep_up@result %>%
 mutate(ID = str_trim(ID, "left"))
 goterms <- read.delim("go_terms.tsv", header = FALSE)
 GOoverrep_up_df <- left_join(GOoverrep_up_df, goterms, by = c("ID" = "V1"))
 GOoverrep_up@result$Description <- GOoverrep_up_df$V2
```

```{r}
# Plot some result figures for up-regulated genes
 GOoverrep_up_df <- GOoverrep_up@result %>%
 mutate(ID = str_trim(ID, "left"))
 goterms <- read.delim("go_terms.tsv", header = FALSE)
 GOoverrep_up_df <- left_join(GOoverrep_up_df, goterms, by = c("ID" = "V1"))
 GOoverrep_up@result$Description <- GOoverrep_up_df$V2
 
 
 barplot(GOoverrep_up, showCategory = 20)
 dotplot(GOoverrep_up, showCategory = 20)
 cnetplot(GOoverrep_up, node_label="all",
 cex_label_gene = 0.8)
 heatplot(GOoverrep_up, showCategory = 10)
```

```{r}
 # Perform GO over-representation analysis for down-regulated genes
 GOoverrep_down <- enricher(gene = down_reg_genes, 
universe = gene_list,
 TERM2GENE = GO2gene)
 head(GOoverrep_down)
 GOoverrep_down
```

```{r}
# Get GO description that is linked to GO ID
 GOoverrep_down_df <- GOoverrep_down@result %>%
 mutate(ID = str_trim(ID, "left"))
 goterms <- read.delim("go_terms.tsv", header = FALSE)
 GOoverrep_down_df <- left_join(GOoverrep_down_df, goterms, by = c("ID" = "V1"))
 GOoverrep_down@result$Description <- GOoverrep_down_df$V2

```

```{r}

```
